annotations.title: Find a college's regional admissions reader

description: Who reads applications from a region at a college: the regional admissions officer's name, title and territory, from the college's own published pages, with the source and the date EduAvenues checked it. Give a college and, optionally, the student's state, region or country. Families in any EduAvenues program see names; other signed-in accounts see how many territories and readers EduAvenues has published for that college. Nothing about the family is read.

region.description: Where the student applies from: a state, region or country, e.g. "Northern Virginia" or "VA"

name: college_reader
